semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Kromax provides high-tech solutions and services across various industries, including semiconductor, but primarily acts as a distributor and integration platform rather than a direct supplier of semiconductor products.
summary: Kromax International Corporation specializes in providing high-tech solutions and services tailored to the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. They offer market research, installation support, logistical support, and process optimization, acting as an integration platform that connects equipment manufacturers and material makers with new markets.

regional_presence.Asia-Pacific: Kromax focuses on serving customers in the Asia-Pacific region, leveraging its extensive industry network.
